speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You present with gait and limb ataxia; please describe your specific medical history in detail, including any past neurological conditions, infections, or exposures. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any changes in your vision or hearing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient reports recent onset of gait instability and limb clumsiness, notably on the right side. Given your history, have you experienced any episodes of dizziness, slurred speech, or double vision alongside these motor symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus antibody status (CSF or serum).

Please confirm if you have noticed any recent cognitive changes, personality shifts, or visual disturbances like blind spots or trouble recognizing faces.
